searchText: Friendly reminder that there's a 1559 implementers' call at 14:00 UTC tomorrow (Thursday, April 30) Agenda: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/167 Zoom: To be posted here shortly before the call. Dan Finlay will also be going over his counter proposal for 1559 (https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/2593) saw Besu has the mining integration done exciting Not yet done but almost <@!273808422753796097> The MAX_GAS_EIP1559 is 20M ? The specification currently set it to 16M. Just to make sure we are on the same page. Both Besu and Geth implementations are using the 16M value for the moment. I assume this is because the proposal was first done with 8M blocks on mainnet, but agreed it'd be a good thing to clarify. Right, I understood the 16M as being twice the target which was 8M back then and it should be updated
